description: Per-run drill-down. Click a link in the top table to zoom into one activity (sets time range + variable). The markdown panel at the bottom lists the prescriptions for every workout.

panels.title: Map — surface type
panels.description: GPS track colored by OSM surface (Valhalla map-matching). Blue-grey=asphalt, tan=compacted, brown=dirt, olive=trail.

targets.query: SELECT "Latitude" FROM "ActivityTrack" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT "Longitude" FROM "ActivityTrack" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT "surf_id" FROM "ActivityTrack" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT "Surface" FROM "ActivityTrack" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

panels.title: Time in HR Zones (%) - reference plan
panels.description: % time per HR zone (Garmin zones at time of recording). Target for Z2-strict easy runs: >75% Z2.

targets.query: SELECT 100.0 * last("hrTimeInZone_1") / (last("hrTimeInZone_1")+last("hrTimeInZone_2")+last("hrTimeInZone_3")+last("hrTimeInZone_4")+last("hrTimeInZone_5")) FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

SELECT 100.0 * last("hrTimeInZone_2") / (last("hrTimeInZone_1")+last("hrTimeInZone_2")+last("hrTimeInZone_3")+last("hrTimeInZone_4")+last("hrTimeInZone_5")) FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

SELECT 100.0 * last("hrTimeInZone_3") / (last("hrTimeInZone_1")+last("hrTimeInZone_2")+last("hrTimeInZone_3")+last("hrTimeInZone_4")+last("hrTimeInZone_5")) FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

SELECT 100.0 * last("hrTimeInZone_4") / (last("hrTimeInZone_1")+last("hrTimeInZone_2")+last("hrTimeInZone_3")+last("hrTimeInZone_4")+last("hrTimeInZone_5")) FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

SELECT 100.0 * last("hrTimeInZone_5") / (last("hrTimeInZone_1")+last("hrTimeInZone_2")+last("hrTimeInZone_3")+last("hrTimeInZone_4")+last("hrTimeInZone_5")) FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

panels.title: Time in Power Zones (%) - computed from per-second
panels.description: % time per power zone, computed on the fly from per-second ActivityGPS (Garmin auto-FTP zones). Z0 = time below the Z1 floor (easy/recovery/descents) added so the bars sum to ~100%.

targets.query: SELECT 100.0 * count("Power") / $activity_end FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Power" >= $z1_pwr AND "Power" < $z2_pwr
SELECT 100.0 * count("Power") / $activity_end FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Power" >= $z2_pwr AND "Power" < $z3_pwr
SELECT 100.0 * count("Power") / $activity_end FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Power" >= $z3_pwr AND "Power" < $z4_pwr
SELECT 100.0 * count("Power") / $activity_end FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Power" >= $z4_pwr AND "Power" < $z5_pwr
SELECT 100.0 * count("Power") / $activity_end FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Power" >= $z5_pwr
SELECT 100.0 * count("Power") / $activity_end FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Power" < $z1_pwr

panels.description: Per-second HR (smoothed) vs duration. Z1-Z5 bands. Purple band = prescribed HR target, purple dashed = median target, orange dashed = avg/step.

targets.query: SELECT "HeartRate" AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "HeartRate" > 60 AND "DurationSeconds" <= $activity_end
SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "d" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT "StepAvgHR" AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "TargetLowBPM" AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "TargetHighBPM" AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT ("TargetLowBPM" + "TargetHighBPM")/2 AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT last("zone1Floor") AS "zf1", last("zone2Floor") AS "zf2", last("zone3Floor") AS "zf3", last("zone4Floor") AS "zf4", last("zone5Floor") AS "zf5" FROM "HRZones" WHERE "sport" =~ /RUNNING/

panels.title: Heart Rate (bpm) — zones + prescribed target

panels.description: Segments the workout by executed step (change in per-second average HR in WorkoutTarget). Each segment = one rep/block, colored by HR zone. The title summarizes the structure with the detected rep count (e.g. 10×(1:00/2:00)). NB: Garmin does not export the rep counter → it is inferred from the target pattern.

targets.query: SELECT "DurationSeconds","StepAvgHR","TargetLowBPM","TargetHighBPM" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "StepStartOffsetS","Notes","IntensityType" FROM "WorkoutStep" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "Distance" AS "gdist", "DurationSeconds" AS "gdur" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Workout Structure — each rep + counts

panels.description: Per-second pace (mm:ss/km). Lower = faster. Orange dashed = avg/step pace.

targets.query: SELECT 1000.0/"Speed" AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Speed" > 0.5 AND "DurationSeconds" <= $activity_end
SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "d" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT 1000.0/"StepAvgSpeed" AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Pace (min/km) + avg/step

panels.description: Per-second power (smoothed) vs duration. Z1-Z5 power bands (extended below Z1 yeard above Z5). Orange dashed = avg/step. Purple band/line = prescribed power target when the workout carries one (rare in running).

targets.query: SELECT "Power" AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Power" > 0 AND "DurationSeconds" <= $activity_end
SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "d" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT "StepAvgPower" AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "TargetLowW" AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "TargetLowW" >= 0 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "TargetHighW" AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "TargetLowW" >= 0 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT ("TargetLowW" + "TargetHighW")/2 AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "TargetLowW" >= 0 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT last("zone1Floor") AS "zf1", last("zone2Floor") AS "zf2", last("zone3Floor") AS "zf3", last("zone4Floor") AS "zf4", last("zone5Floor") AS "zf5" FROM "PowerZones" WHERE "sport" =~ /RUNNING/

panels.title: Power (W) — zones + avg/step

panels.description: Per-second cadence (×2) vs duration. Green band = target cadence 170-190 spm. Orange dashed = avg/step. (Runs carry no Garmin RPM target: no purple band.)

targets.query: SELECT "Cadence" * 2 AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Cadence" > 30 AND "DurationSeconds" <= $activity_end
SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "d" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT "StepAvgCadence" * 2 AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "TargetLowRPM" * 2 AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "TargetLowRPM" >= 0 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT "TargetHighRPM" * 2 AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "TargetLowRPM" >= 0 ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT ("TargetLowRPM" * 2 + "TargetHighRPM" * 2)/2 AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "TargetLowRPM" >= 0 ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Cadence (spm) — target 170-190 + avg/step

panels.description: Per-second stride length (m). Orange dashed = avg/step.

targets.query: SELECT "Step_Length"/1000 AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Step_Length" > 0 AND "DurationSeconds" <= $activity_end
SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "d" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT "StepAvgStride" / 1000 AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Stride Length (m) + avg/step

panels.description: Per-second Vertical Ratio (%). Green <7% = good efficiency. Orange dashed = avg/step.

targets.query: SELECT "Vertical_Ratio" AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Vertical_Ratio" > 0 AND "DurationSeconds" <= $activity_end
SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "d" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'
SELECT "StepAvgVR" AS "v" FROM "WorkoutTarget" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Vertical Ratio (%) — target <7%

targets.query: SELECT "Vertical_Oscillation"/10 AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Vertical_Oscillation" > 0 AND "DurationSeconds" <= $activity_end
SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "d" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

panels.description: Per-second ground contact time (ms). Green <260 = good.

targets.query: SELECT "Stance_Time" AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Stance_Time" > 0 AND "DurationSeconds" <= $activity_end
SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "d" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

panels.title: Ground Contact Time (ms) — target <260

panels.description: Average HR per lap, colored by EFFICIENCY (GAP pace / HR, vs the average of the first fresh laps): green = efficient, red = real cardiac drift. GAP neutralizes grade, so a red lap = true drift (fatigue/heat), NOT a hill. Altitude in the background. Global Pa:HR decoupling (excluding first 10 min, 1st vs 2nd half) shown top-right — Friel thresholds <5/5-7/>7 %.

targets.query: SELECT "Avg_HR" AS "lhr","Max_HR" AS "lmax","Ascent" AS "lasc","Descent" AS "ldesc","Distance" AS "ldist","Elapsed_Time" AS "lela" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT "DurationSeconds" AS "gdur","HeartRate" AS "ghr","GradeAdjustedSpeed" AS "ggap","Altitude" AS "galt" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Altitude" > 0 ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT last("zone1Floor") AS "zone1floor", last("zone2Floor") AS "zone2floor", last("zone3Floor") AS "zone3floor", last("zone4Floor") AS "zone4floor", last("zone5Floor") AS "zone5floor", last("lactateThresholdHeartRate") AS "lactatethreshold", last("maxHeartRate") AS "maxheartrate" FROM "HRZones" WHERE "sport" =~ /RUNNING/

panels.title: HR per lap — drift (GAP/HR efficiency) + altitude

panels.description: GROUNDED on ActivityGPS (selector 20260522T083908UTC verified): Distance=cumulative meters, DurationSeconds=1Hz seconds, Altitude>0 filter, HeartRate=bpm. Pace derived from time/distance (Report B), never from Speed. Per-km algorithm exactly matches Report B (d>=lo && d<hi contig

targets.query: SELECT "Distance" AS "d","DurationSeconds" AS "t","Altitude" AS "alt","HeartRate" AS "hr" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector"='$activity' AND "Altitude">0 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Per-km splits
Elevation Profile — colored by grade
panels.description: Altitude vs distance (ActivityGPS), line+area colored by grade (blue descent → green flat → red climb). Tooltip Distance/Elevation/Grade. Surface + Way type added via visualMap once ActivitySurface (Valhalla) is populated.

targets.query: SELECT "Distance" AS "distance", "Altitude" AS "altitude" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Altitude" > 0
SELECT "surface","waytype","start_m","end_m" FROM "ActivitySurface" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Workout Analysis
panels.description: Per-step workout analysis: horizontal bars colored by TYPE (Warm-up/Cool-down=blue, Rep=orange, Recovery=green, Rest=grey), length ∝ speed. Elev figure colored by grade (blue=descent → red=climb), HR figure colored by HR zone (green Z2 → red Z5).

targets.query: SELECT "Index" AS "lapidx","Intensity" AS "intensity","Distance" AS "dist","Elapsed_Time" AS "secs","Avg_HR" AS "hr","Ascent" AS "asc","Descent" AS "desc" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivitySelector"='$activity' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Surface & path-type breakdown
panels.description: Breakdown by surface and by way type (ActivitySurface / Valhalla).

targets.query: SELECT "surface","waytype","length_m" FROM "ActivitySurface" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity'

panels.title: Elevation Profile — colored by surface
panels.description: Same profile, bands colored by OSM surface (Asphalt/Compacted/Dirt/Trail…). Tooltip surface + way type + grade.

targets.query: SELECT "Distance" AS "distance","Altitude" AS "altitude" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' AND "Altitude" > 0
SELECT "surface","waytype","start_m","end_m" FROM "ActivitySurface" WHERE "ActivitySelector" = '$activity' ORDER BY time
